leads.claim: A 1949 conference on aerial phenomena was held at Los Alamos Scientific Laboratory involving eminent scientists.
leads.why: The document describes a scientific conference on aerial phenomena but provides no evidence of physical material recovery or custody.

leads.claim: Astronauts discussed the 'light flash phenomena' caused by cosmic rays striking the retina.
leads.why: This refers to a well-documented biological effect of cosmic radiation on the human eye, not biological material from a UAP.

doc_verdict: This document contains no information suggesting the government or its contractors obtained, held, or analyzed physical material from a UAP.
